ينصرم (form VII)
# يَنْصَرِمُ (yanṣarimu) /jan.sˤa.ri.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
# يَنْصَرِمَ (yanṣarima) /jan.sˤa.ri.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
# يَنْصَرِمْ (yanṣarim) /jan.sˤa.rim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
